GIGABYTE H610M K DDR4 – Specifications

  • Chipset: Intel H610

  • Socket: LGA1700

  • Form Factor: Micro-ATX

  • CPU Support: Intel Core 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen processors

  • Memory Slots: 2 × DDR4 DIMM

  • Maximum Memory: 64GB

  • Memory Speeds: Up to DDR4-3200

  • PCIe Slots:

    • 1 × PCIe 4.0 x16

    • 1 × PCIe 3.0 x1

  • Storage:

    • 1 × M.2 NVMe PCIe 3.0 x4

    • 2 × SATA 6Gb/s

  • Graphics Output:

    • 1 × HDMI 2.1

  • Network:

    • Gigabit LAN

  • Audio:

    • Realtek HD Audio (7.1-channel)

  • USB Ports:

    • USB 3.2 Gen 1

    • USB 2.0

  • Fan Headers:

    • 1 × CPU Fan

    • 1 × System Fan

  • BIOS Features:

    • UEFI BIOS

    • Q-Flash

    • Smart Fan 6

Suitable for:

  • Intel Core i3-12100F / i5-12400F / i5-13400F

  • Budget gaming and office PCs

  • DDR4 memory builds

Limitations:

  • Only 2 RAM slots

  • Only 1 M.2 slot

  • No CPU overclocking support

  • Basic power delivery, not ideal for high-end CPUs like i7/i9 K-series under heavy loads.
